snippet.title: [Trailer] Isle Frontier (Early 2025)
snippet.description:
Make a life of your own in this isometric point-and-click life simulator! Craft items, build furniture, and level up your skills to become a legendary frontiersman. The island has everything you need to not only survive, but thrive!

Available now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486520/Isle_Frontier/
#indiegame #steamgame #cozygaming #cozygames #lifesim
